respaldo: Drawn arrow from User to Route 53 labeled https://orion; speaker notes user accesses Orion portal and DNS resolves via Route 53
Drawn arrow from Route 53 to ALB; speaker confirms Route 53 resolves DNS to the ALB
Drawn arrow from ALB to Spot node; speaker mentions ALB sends request to pods running on Spot instances
Drawn arrow from EKS downward to Spot; speaker mentions EKS serves as the container orchestrator
Drawn arrow from Spot pointing to microservices hub (M.S. 1, 2, 3); speaker explains application creates Kubernetes jobs for each microservice
Drawn curved line from microservices to SNS; speaker states job sends an event to Amazon SNS
Drawn arrow from SNS to SQS; speaker confirms SNS fans out the message to SQS
Drawn arrow from SQS back to microservices jobs; speaker notes replacement jobs watch SQS to pick up unfinished jobs
